sources.label: BetterPlaridel editors
sources.notes: The first six services are the most requested; the home page lists them as "Popular services". The locations are a template: office names follow directory.json, and each office, its building, photo and description must be verified before launch. Locations with "sample": true are dummy entries for testing the layout (Jobs (PESO)); delete them before launch.

services.title: Civil Registry
services.body: Birth, marriage and death certificates, and late registration.

locations.name: Local Civil Registrar
locations.description: Registers births, marriages and deaths, and issues certified copies and late registrations.

services.title: Business Permits
services.body: New and renewal business permits, and requirements checklist.

locations.name: Office of the Mayor — Business Permit
locations.description: Processes new and renewal business permits, and gives out the requirements checklist.

services.title: Cedula
services.body: Community Tax Certificate for employment, permits and transactions.

locations.name: Treasurer's Office
locations.description: Issues the Community Tax Certificate (cedula) for individuals and businesses.

services.title: Real Property Tax
services.body: Amilyar payment schedule, discounts and tax declarations.

locations.name: Treasurer's Office
locations.description: Accepts real property tax (amilyar) payments.

locations.name: Assessor's Office
locations.description: Issues tax declarations and keeps the town's property assessment records.

services.title: Health Services
services.body: Rural Health Unit, vaccinations, check-ups and health programs.

locations.name: Rural Health Unit
locations.description: Check-ups, vaccinations, maternal care and the town's health programs.

locations.name: Bulihan Health Center
locations.description: Barangay health station for residents of Bulihan.

services.title: Social Welfare
services.body: MSWDO assistance, senior citizen, PWD and solo parent IDs.

locations.name: Municipal Social Welfare Office
locations.description: Financial and crisis assistance, and PWD and solo parent IDs.

locations.name: Senior Citizens Office
locations.description: Senior citizen IDs and benefits.

services.title: Jobs (PESO)

locations.description: Job referrals, resume help and employment assistance.

locations.name: Job Fair Booth B

locations.description: Guidance for overseas job applicants and returning workers.

locations.description: Sign-ups for short skills courses and certifications.

locations.name: Career Coaching Desk
locations.description: Mock interviews and career guidance for first-time job seekers.

locations.name: Health Worker Hiring
locations.description: Openings for barangay health workers and midwives.

locations.name: Livelihood Desk
locations.description: Starter kits and livelihood seminars for residents.

locations.name: Barangay Jobs Board
locations.description: Local openings posted by businesses in Bulihan.
